name: MotionUI
summary: After Effects plugin for animating interface designs, with a Figma import and Claude-driven scene building, for Mac and Windows.
best_for: motion designers and product designers who animate interface screens in After Effects and want to bring Figma frames in and let Claude help build the scenes
skip_if: you do not use After Effects, you need a clear refund policy before you pay, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: The free plan leaves out the Figma import and most effects, so the main workflow needs Pro. The page text shows no refund terms, and you need After Effects (and Figma for the import) as separate products.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro monthly · Pro billed monthly, cancel any time
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-10 on motionui.net, US dollars) MotionUI has a Free plan and a Pro plan. Free costs $0, needs no credit card and covers basic animation presets and easing, rectangle rigs and 2 text effects. Pro costs $19 a month billed monthly, or $168 a year, which the page shows as $14 a month and a 26% saving. Pro adds the Figma import, every animation tool, all 10 text effects, the cursor builder and the Claude and Codex scene building; the page lists Premiere Pro editing through Claude as part of Pro. Both plans run on macOS and Windows, and the page says you can cancel any time. A promo line on the site offers 1 month of Pro free with a code. The page shows no refund terms in the text we read, and links a separate refund policy page that we did not open. Whether the plugin also needs an After Effects or Figma subscription is up to those products and is not priced here. We did not open checkout, so the tax added is not known.
